reported_not_in_this_evidence.note: read from the campaign driver's log and from live read-only inspections while the residents ran; these facts are not carried by the twelve stage files and cannot be reproduced from this directory

not_passed.cause: Every incomplete attempt is an outbound exchange left at outbound_request_prepared. The candidate deliberately records an outbound attempt as uncertain, without a terminal audit phase, when its request was fully sent and no reply byte came back. A resident at its incoming_workers limit of 1 accepts and drops a second concurrent connection without replying, and three replicas synchronizing with each peer every second collide continually. A worker that cannot open the store drops an accepted connection the same way, with no reply, no audit row and no rejected-connection increment. Audit events are immutable, so the count never returns to zero.
not_passed.inheritance_note: incomplete_attempt_count is folded from every row ever written to exchange_audit_events, which is delete-proof and update-proof by SQLite trigger. An attempt is retired only by a later row carrying the same attempt identifier, and those identifiers are minted per process and exist only in its memory. The three residents have exited, so these counts are a permanent floor of these stores: a later campaign run against them starts here. Campaign 2's own active-baseline shows the same inheritance from campaign 1.
